main_body: prehistoric palm/cycad tree with frond canopy and tall straight trunk
top_band: upper crown bud and top fronds (light/mid green, rows 0-7)
evidence: The canopy shows a central top bud/crown (rows 1-6) with radiating fronds sloping down (rows 7-22) overhanging the vertical trunk (rows 18-54) with a clear under-canopy shadow.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, organic leaf clumping and rooted trunks of the Beodeul tree references, the candidate has a rigid, repetitive straight trunk (4px wide column with repeating 3-row pattern) and heavy near-black outlines around the central bud and fronds, giving it a much simpler, flatter look.
